title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Saturday, 10 October 2026
description: Meta and Sierra's new Personal Agent Protocol and Masayoshi Son's reported $100 billion AI-robotics fund push, the Wallabies chasing history against the All Blacks and two survivors of a light aircraft crash, Queensland's doubling mental injury claims and a wetter far-north spring outlook, plus construction starting on the Gold Coast's new marine wildlife hospital. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
